name: Bm Blues — shuffle at 130
description: A minor blues in B minor at 130 bpm, 12-bar form Bm Bm Bm Bm | Em Em Bm Bm | F#7 Em Bm F#7, shuffle feel (swung eighths: the off-beat eighth sits 4 ticks late, on the triplet). Rows 1-9 drums, A-E bass (A-C are one-bar boogie SUBROUTINES that D strings together), F-G organ, H-K lick SUBROUTINES that both the harmonica (L) and the guitar (M) call, N octave groups, O-T sections, U ending bass, V a backing track to play over. Row 0 plays the whole song. W-Z are free for your own.
prompt: another MPL bank: a blues beat, key of Bm at 130 bpm
